crossRefs.note: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men.
Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance…
Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
“Now therefore, what do I do here,” says Yahweh, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over…

translations.web: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
translations.bsb: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
translations.kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
translations.asv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day.
